about: Where each part of @origingame/engine-knowledge lands in the platform's production tree: the project skeleton as one scaffold overlay. Nothing else is mounted: the generated API wiki with its guides (wiki/), the style catalogue (looks/) and the look presets (presets/) stay in the engine package, where `og api find`/`og api show` and the art brief (scripts/brief.ts) read them. `@template/` is packages/create/template in the engine repository and scaffold/template/ in the published package.
